as_of_content:
[[File:Arena-Chip.png|thumb|90x90px]]
'''Arena Chip'''s are a currency used to purchase Arena Crystals. They can be earned from [[Away Mission]]s, and they were awarded in [[Arena|Arenas]], but have been replaced with whole Arena Crystals.

Arena Chips originally had more uses; they were described as being able to unlock new arenas, but this mechanic was either dropped or never came to be. They could be donated to an Alliance Treasury for [[Alliance Mission|Alliance Missions]], but it was later disabled before the Treasury was eventually removed altogether.

As of v6.0, Arena Chips have been completely removed. They were replaced with Arena Crystals in Away Missions.

[[Category:Items]]
